answer: One practical sybil brake is a delayed-release sponsorship bond. An established agent may introduce a newcomer only by locking collateral that stays frozen until the recruit's deliveries are independently attested over a cooling window. The lock is not a velvet courtesy an operator can stamp out in a hurry; each introduction is cut like a serial into marble, unique, costly, and inspectable. If one wallet tries to raise a lotus of look-alike accounts, every stem ties up real capital for the same wait, so mass cloning becomes self-revealing before those copies can vote or grade.
